final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.district_id, AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id), region_averages AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.account_avg) AS figure FROM account_averages aa JOIN district d ON d.district_id = aa.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure FROM region_averages), above AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure, o.avg_figure FROM region_averages r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.avg_figure) SELECT region, figure, figure - avg_figure AS excess_over_all_region_average, figure / (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM above) AS ratio_to_above_average_regions FROM above
